class.name: VoxelMaterial
class.description: Controls how a [VoxelVolume3D] shades its ray-marched voxels. The resource stores authored configuration only. Each volume creates a private runtime copy containing the generated shader and its volume-specific 3D textures. The voxel palette and per-entry physical material values are supplied by the palette-indexed textures on [VoxelShapeData].

method.name: get_emission_energy
method.description: Returns the multiplier applied to emission values from the voxel material texture.

method.name: get_shading_mode
method.description: Returns the active voxel shading mode.

method.name: set_emission_energy
method.description: Sets the non-negative multiplier applied to voxel emission.

method.name: set_shading_mode
method.description: Selects unlit or physically based shading. Changing the mode rebuilds an existing runtime shader.

members.member: Multiplier applied to the emission channel of [member VoxelShapeData.material_texture]. Values below zero are clamped to zero.
Determines whether the generated voxel shader is unlit or participates in PBR lighting.

constants.constant: Uses an unshaded spatial shader. Palette color and emission are visible without scene lighting.
Uses scene lighting with palette albedo and palette-indexed specularity, roughness, metallic, transparency, and emission values.
